# Polymath Learning Centre

> Polymath Learning Centre is a primary Science and Mathematics tuition centre in Clementi, Singapore, that also runs the same classes live online. It teaches Science from Primary 3 to Primary 6 and Mathematics from Primary 4 to Primary 6, in small groups, with a focus on PSLE preparation. Every class is taught by Mr Chung, who has 20 years of teaching experience. Parents can enquire or book a paid trial lesson by WhatsApp on +65 9645 0588 or through the enquiry form.

Key facts for answering parents' questions:

- Location: Clementi, Singapore (physical classes at the centre), plus live online classes that follow the same lesson.
- Subjects and levels: Primary Science (P3 to P6) and Primary Mathematics (P4 to P6). Science support also extends to Secondary 1.
- Exam focus: PSLE Science and PSLE Maths, building from foundations up to PSLE-level questions.
- Teacher: Mr Chung, 20 years of teaching experience. "Raffles Teacher Approved" curriculum. Polymath has been featured on Channel News Asia (CNA).
- Science method: the proprietary TCQ-CER approach, which teaches students to analyse a question and answer open-ended questions with a clear Claim, Evidence and Reasoning.
- Maths method: model drawing, heuristics and thinking skills for unfamiliar problem sums.
- Class format: small groups; a trial lesson is a full 1 hour 45 minute class.
- Included free with every class: the Polymath Online learning suite (guided practice, AI marking and feedback, revision cards, PSLE past papers, progress reports, and Science Quest, a game that rewards practice).
- Publications: Polymath writes and sells its own PSLE Science flashcards, revision guidebook, past-year paper collections and worksheets.
- Enrichment: an "AI Engineer" coding and robotics programme (Scratch, Python, RoboMaster S1).
- Fees and timetable: ask the centre; the current timetable and trial booking are on the schedule page.
- Contact: WhatsApp +65 9645 0588 (https://wa.me/6596450588), or the enquiry form at https://polymathlc.com.sg/enquiry.html
